Measured in github.com/pulumi/pulumi/sdk/v3/go/pulumi/types_builtins.go:9449,9483: both pulumi.String and pulumi.StringOutput carry ToStringPtrOutput, so the five Inputs still take either and only a value whose static type is the pulumi.StringInput interface stops compiling; the seven plain ones need pulumi.StringRef.

contractChangeCensus.rollout: A consumer meets none of this until it moves its envoy-infra pin and regenerates its SDK, which is dispatch://INFRA-775's job. The new refusals reach no existing caller: each fires only when the new opt-in clusterOnly is set, and no stack sets it. An applied stack that sets nothing new sends nothing new, since clusterOnly has no schema default and requiredInputs only shrinks, from fifteen to region and hostname.
